name: APIG token business-logic flaw
summary: APIG's transfer accounting credits a self-transfer without preserving the sender debit. The attack helper doubled its APIG balance with 28 self-transfers, then spent the inflated balance into two PancakeSwap pairs and removed their USDT and BETH reserves.
notes: APIG is a directly deployed token. Its 18,531-byte runtime is absent one block before creation and has code hash 0x0eb67ad4103b1e19c7d9c66b6bbf1e0df04b80b97d30658f2d027b9cd11ef8f7 at deployment and immediately before exploitation; both EIP-1967 code-selection slots are zero. The self-transfer inflation is in the deployed transfer path and does not depend on later configuration.

The receipt shows APIG/USDT pair 0xefbf31b0ca397d29e9ba3fb37fe3c013ee32871d receive the attacker's 500-USDT input and pay 72,628.575425255057150292 USDT, for 72,128.575425255057150292 USDT of net depletion; APIG/BETH pair 0xb920456aec6e88c68c16c8294688b2b63c81b2ce pays 59.5 BETH. Archive pair balances at the surrounding block boundary reproduce both amounts. The USDT loss includes the 1.5-USDT financing fee paid from victim depletion. BETH uses the closest preceding DefiLlama ETH price point, $1,625.46 at 1694174103.
Replaces the seed's rounded attacker-proceeds estimate with exact victim-pair depletion; financing fees remain part of gross loss.
